feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag magbigay ng gamot ng iba. Ayon sa lokal na protocol at kwalipikadong payo ang gamot.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not give another person's tablets. Medicine follows local protocol and qualified advice.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Humingi muna ng agarang medikal na tulong at pagpahingahin ang tao.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Activate urgent assessment first and keep the person at rest.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag ipagpaliban ang tawag para maghanap ng gamot. Tumawag muna.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not delay the call to find medication. Call first.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Iulat ang simula, sintomas at alam na gamot o allergy.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Report onset, symptoms and known medicines or allergies.

feedback_by_option.fil: Iulat ang nakikita, hindi ang hula sa sanhi. Hindi batayan ng diagnosis ang kuwento.
feedback_by_option.en: Report what you see, not a guessed cause. The story is not grounds for a diagnosis.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag magreseta ng aspirin. Ayon sa lokal na protocol at kwalipikadong payo ang gamot.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not prescribe aspirin. Medicine follows local protocol and qualified advice.
